tha-ap524:1.1: Pecchadāyaka.] Vipassino bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / ekapecchaṃ mayā dinnaṃ pasannena sapāṇinā. // //
tha-ap524:2.1: Hatthiyānaṃ assayānaṃ dibbayānaṃ samajjhagaṃ / tena pecchakadānenā patto 'mhi āsavakkhayaṃ. // //
tha-ap524:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ peccham adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pecchadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap524:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pecchadyako thero i. g. a-ti.
